_comment: This file is a dependency injection registration module with no standalone callable APIs or CLI-usable entry points. It contains only the internal _register_sampling function that wires up sampling components (SequenceGenerator, Seq2SeqGenerator, TopPSampler, TopKSampler) into a DependencyContainer. Per instructions: skip files that do not have code callable with a simple argparse CLI module.
review_register_sampling: review the _register_sampling function that wires SequenceGenerator, Seq2SeqGenerator, TopPSampler, and TopKSampler into a DependencyContainer
summarize_sampling_registration: summarize the fairseq2 sampling composition module that registers sampling-based generators and samplers as dependency injection components
refactor_create_seq_generator: refactor the create_seq_generator inner factory to support additional generator configuration options
test_top_p_sampler_factory: test the create_top_p_sampler factory that constructs a TopPSampler from a TopPSamplerConfig
review_top_k_sampler_registration: review the create_top_k_sampler factory that constructs a TopKSampler from a TopKSamplerConfig
